name: Specific Local Objectives Polygon (DLR)
description: Specific Local Objectives Polygon (DLR) — published by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council.

OBJECTIVE_1: Enhance the character, ambiance and quality of the environment, historic streetscapes and public realm of the residential streets in the areas adjoining Lower George's Street, Dún Laoghaire, (see Objective 152 for full text)

To develop a sports facility at the site known as the “8-acre field” that will incorporate a new pavilion for golf, indoor hall and changing rooms in association with an all weather pitch, tennis courts and a bowling green.
To facilitate the provision of an access from South County Business Park to the car parks within Central Park.
To preserve trees, woodlands and amenity gardens at Fernhill.
To protect and conserve Ballyman Glen and proposed candidate Special Areas of Conservation.
To protect and conserve Knocksink Wood proposed candidate Special Area of Conservation.
To protect and conserve South Dublin Bay Candidate Special Area of Conservation.
To protect and conserve the Wicklow Mountains National Park and proposed candidate Special Area of Conservation.
To protect the Dalkey Railway tunnel corridor for railway purposes in the interest of railway safety

To provide for a number of holiday caravan/camping facilities within a 1km radius of the cross roads at Glencullen subject to the following;  ensuring that there is not an over proliferation of such facilities
To provide for primary and post primary education facilities at Legionaries of Christ lands at Stillorgan Indusrial Estate-Benildus Avenue.
To retain, improve and encourage the provision of sustainable neighbourhood infrastructure facilities within the outlined group of buildings / land
To seek the renewal of the obsolete area at George’s Place and the Fire Station.
